name: phone-a-friend
why: Opens on the Millionaire audience beating the expert 91% to 65%; YOU phones 535 members of Congress who hold the question upside down, answer C pays them and blows up the studio, and Wishonia unplugs the phone and lights her own name in neon.

name: bribe-eight-billion
why: Opens on every industry fitting through Congress's coin slot at once; the weapons factory runs out of bills on the third of 8 billion voters, has to dress up as a hospital, ties its billboard's arrow in a knot, and is reduced to making an argument while the lobbyists faint.

name: friend-is-bribed
why: Opens on "Your friend is being bribed" as the expert's booth and the senator's light three lamps; the senator's darts hit a sensible budget only by bouncing, he rises on 30 years of envelopes, and the same $127 million that gets the expert hooked off stage puts the audience to sleep when it's called lobbying.
